Subject: CSA: transfer of control ownership + evidence automation proposal

Hi Julie —

Thanks again for walking through the CAIQ last week. Per our discussion I pulled together a lightweight proposal to: (1) reassign a small set of control owners to your org for the Helios assessment, and (2) prototype an automated evidence collection flow to reduce manual handoffs.

Attached is a first-pass control map (redwood_caiq_control_map_v0.2.xlsx) that shows our suggested owner changes and an "evidence grade" column indicating which items we think are automation candidates. The goal is to minimize back-and-forth for runtime logs and config artifacts.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm which control owners you want to accept by EOD Thu (2 July).
- We spin up a 2-week automation POC that pulls evidence (logs, IAM snapshots, KMS rotation events) into a shared S3/GDrive bundle.
- Joint demo at the end of the POC; if successful we expand to remaining controls.

Can you confirm owner acceptance and preferred POC start date? I looped Priyom and Kimberly to scope engineering and legal/compliance inputs.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Alex —

Appreciate the clear plan and the control map. A few quick notes from our side: 

- We can take ownership for the following control families: IAM (A6), Logging & Monitoring (A10), and Key Management (A9).
- Prioritize automation for runtime logs and KMS rotation events — those cause the most manual work for our audit team.
- Procurement (Tim) asked for an intake artifact (single CSV) that lists the piece of evidence, expected path/location, and TTL for retention; that will speed approvals.

We are comfortable starting the POC the week of July 12. If Redwood can drop an evidence_inventory_sample.csv that has the columns Tim requested, we can route to our security ops and procurement for a quick green-light.

Julie Park

Julie / Alex —

This sounds straightforward and aligns with the automation playbook we piloted earlier this year. A couple operational clarifications from engineering's side:

- POC scope: collect KMS rotation metadata (Cloud KMS and AWS KMS), consolidated audit logs for inference endpoints (30d window), and IAM role snapshots (current bindings + last-change timestamp).
- Data flows: we recommend a read-only cross-account role into a staging bucket (Helios-owned) to avoid credentials exchange. Redwood will push sanitized manifests and links; Helios retains direct ownership of the bucket.
- Timeline: 2 full weeks for POC, with a mid-POC sync after week 1. Engineers estimate ~4 engineer-days to wire the first control family.

I attached an evidence_inventory_sample.csv and a short automation-proposal.pdf to show required columns and the manifest format we will push. If that format works for procurement, we can template the rest of the CSA responses off these manifests.

I also recommend Kimberly review retention/PII flags before we finalize manifests — some runtime logs have user-identifying strings that need redaction rules.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Platform Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CSA: transfer of control ownership + evidence automation proposal

Julie —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for picking the control families. A few compliance notes from our side before POC kickoff: 

- Retention/PII: We will add a redaction step for logs that may contain user-identifying strings. The evidence manifest will include a "redaction_required" boolean column.
- Legal & Contract: To formalize owner transfer for the three control families during the assessment, we'll update the CSA cover memo (one-page) that lists accepted owners and the effective date. That memo will sit with your procurement ticket.
- Audit trace: All automated pushes will include a signed manifest (SHA256) and a lightweight access log (who/when/pushed-by).

I attached a draft of the one-page CSA-owner-transfer memo (inline below) — if you confirm acceptance we will finalize and push to the procurement ticket.

Draft CSA Owner Transfer Memo:
- Account: Helios Health
- Controls transferred: IAM (A6), Key Management (A9), Logging (A10)
- Effective date: 2026-07-12 (start of automation POC)
- Evidence delivery: Staging bucket (Helios-owned) + signed manifest

Please confirm and we will schedule the kickoff for July 12.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Principal Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
